title: The Number That Does the Work
gist_ar: شرح غير منظّم لمؤشر مركّب: المشكلة إن رقم واحد بيخبّي تسع حاجات مختلفة.

before_listening.en: A statistician explaining an index informally. Work out what he thinks it is safe to use it for.
before_listening.ar: إحصائي بيشرح مؤشر بشكل غير رسمي. استنتج هو شايف إنه آمن يُستخدم في إيه.

segments.speaker: Statistician
segments.text: So the index. Nine indicators, and the first thing to say — actually no, let me do this the other way round. Air quality has a threshold. There's a level above which harm is documented, we know where it is, it's a real number. Institutional trust does not have one. Nobody has ever specified the point at which trust becomes insufficient, because there isn't one. And we average them. We normalise both to one-to-ten and we average them, and the moment you do that you've asserted that a point of trust and a point of air quality are the same size, which — they're not, they're not even the same kind of thing. The extent to which people rely on the composite is what worries me. A city moves four places, and the press writes it up, and when you go and look, the movement is in three indicators none of which is individually significant. So it's precise. It's precise to two decimal places and it isn't accurate, and those get confused constantly. Where it does work — and it does work — is the wide comparison. If two cities are a long way apart, further apart than the error, the ranking holds, and we've validated that four times. Fine. Use it for that. The bands are quantiles, by the way, which means a difference of nought point two can move you a category, and the appendix says so, and I have never met anyone who read the appendix. And the last thing, which is really the first thing. If somebody asks you what a city's score means, the honest answer is that it means where that city sits relative to other cities on nine things we chose. Not how good it is. Those are not the same sentence and only one of them is defensible.

gist_question.q: What does he think the index is safe to be used for?
gist_question.q_ar: هو شايف المؤشر آمن يُستخدم في إيه؟
options: Tracking a single city's year-on-year movement, which it measures reliably
Setting the threshold for air quality
Comparing cities that are far apart, further than the error

questions.q: What is his objection to averaging the indicators?
questions.q_ar: إيه اعتراضه على حساب متوسط المؤشرات؟
options: It asserts a point of trust and a point of air quality are the same size
Air quality has no documented threshold

questions.q: What distinction does he say gets confused constantly?
questions.q_ar: أنهي فرق بيقول إنه بيتلخبط دايمًا؟

questions.q: What does he say about the appendix?
options: It states the limitation, and he has never met anyone who read it
It contradicts the index's own rankings and calls for the composite to be dropped
